idea-plugin.name: Required Dependencies Manager
idea-plugin.description:
Required Dependencies Manager allows developers to seamlessly manage and configure project-required plugins directly inside the native Settings > Plugins interface.

直接在 IDE 原生 Settings > Plugins（插件管理）界面中便捷管理和配置当前项目的必需插件。

English

✨ Key Features

  • Native Plugins UI Integration: Manage required plugins directly in the standard Settings / Preferences > Plugins window.
  • Marketplace Batch Installation: Pins uninstalled required plugins at the top of the Marketplace tab with a one-click Install All action.
  • Installed Batch Enabling: Pins disabled required plugins at the top of the Installed tab with a one-click Enable All action.
  • Card Badges & Context Menu: Displays a distinctive Required badge on plugin cards and provides right-click context menu options to mark or unmark required status instantly.
  • Detailed Version Constraints: Configure minimum (Min) and maximum (Max) version constraints in the plugin details pane, with a quick button to fill the currently installed version.
  • Dedicated Search Filter: Use /tag:Required in the search bar to filter and count project-required plugins instantly.

📖 Usage

  1. Open Settings / Preferences > Plugins.
  2. Mark as Required: Right-click any plugin card, or check Set as project required plugin in the plugin details pane.
  3. Version Constraints: Optionally set Min/Max versions in the details pane.
  4. Quick Filter: Type /tag:Required in the search bar to show all required plugins.
  5. Batch Setup: When missing plugins, click Install All in Marketplace or Enable All in Installed.
  6. Click Apply or OK to save.

简体中文

✨ 核心特性

  • 原生 Plugins 界面无缝增强：直接在日常使用的 Settings / Preferences > Plugins 界面中操作，无需跳转子菜单。
  • Marketplace 置顶与一键安装：在 Marketplace 顶部置顶展示当前项目“未安装的必需插件”分组，支持一键全部安装。
  • Installed 置顶与一键启用：在 Installed 顶部置顶展示当前项目“未启用的必需插件”分组，支持一键全部启用。
  • 卡片专属徽标与右键菜单：列表卡片直观展示 Required 徽标，并支持右键卡片快捷标记或取消标记。
  • 版本区间精准约束：在插件详情页配置最低（Min）与最高（Max）版本限制，支持一键填入当前版本。
  • 搜索栏专属过滤：在搜索框输入或选择 /tag:Required 即可快速筛选出当前项目的所有必需插件。

📖 使用说明

  1. 打开 Settings / Preferences > Plugins。
  2. 标记必需插件：右键任意插件卡片选择“设为当前项目必需插件”，或在插件详情页勾选“设为当前项目必需插件”。
  3. 版本约束配置：按需在详情页中设定最低/最高版本限制。
  4. 快速检索：在搜索栏输入 /tag:Required 快速筛选所有必需插件。
  5. 一键装配：在 Marketplace 顶部点击“全部安装”，或在 Installed 顶部点击“全部启用”。
  6. 点击 Apply 或 OK 保存即可。
